ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Clear screen
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Pickle steps that close every window another mod owns and keep them closed for the rest of the scenario, so a click is not swallowed by a log viewer or a notice. Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See ClearScreen/README.md at the repository root.
It is the same pair of steps as the one proposed to Pickle itself as a pull request; when that lands this mod can go.
